explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Namur (1692)" (revision 1370743846) says: "Concerned that King William III planned to recapture the stronghold, King Louis XIV subsequently ordered his commander-in-chief, the duc de Luxembourg, to join battle with the Allies in the field, resulting in the bloody Battle of Steenkerque on 3 August." The edge reads that sentence as: Siege of Namur (1692) caused Battle of Steenkerque, and nothing more.
